target_statement: Kernel-formalize the existing seven-column palindrome-ancestry certificates of proofs/contributions/2026-10-15-seven-column-prefix for the three-digit prefixes 218, 777 and 217, in that order. For each prefix abc with bound h (218:34, 777:25, 217:23): for every positive ordinary decimal integer A, every t and every palindrome P whose canonical decimal numeral begins with the digits a,b,c (any width, any interior digits, intermediate palindromes allowed), Lychrel196.orbit A t = P implies t <= h; consequently, for every t, Lychrel196.orbit 196 t is not a palindrome beginning with abc. No native_decide, no new axioms, no sorry. No P196 claim, no optimality claim for 34/25/23, no claim about any other prefix.
